title: ArchitectureInvariants
description: Persistent, whole-project structural constraints and invariants for the Architecture Model (.solidsdd/architecture/invariants.yaml). Declares rules ABOUT the Structurizr DSL model (.solidsdd/architecture/workspace.dsl); does not duplicate the model's elements/relationships. Referenced element ids must exist in workspace.dsl (checked by scripts/solidsdd-architecture/validate.py, not by this schema alone).

constraints.description: Mechanically checkable structural constraints, mirroring ArchitecturePlan.constraints[].

invariants.description: Prose Architecture Invariants (structural conditions to maintain, not behavior or formal state properties). One sentence each, e.g. 'Domain must not depend on Infrastructure.'

from.description: Element id in workspace.dsl (underscore identifier form). Required for type: forbid_dependency.

to.description: Element id in workspace.dsl (underscore identifier form). Required for type: forbid_dependency.

scope.description: For type: no_cycles. 'all' checks the whole relationship graph. Omit 'from'/'to' when scope is 'all'.
